title: unhappy
description: the modpack for the unhappy smp, improves world gen, wildlife and plantlife, and the vanilla experience
body: Modpack for the Unhappy SMP. A collection of mods to improve vanilla experience. Adds more wildlife and plantlife, more compelling world generation and stuctures, furniture and building tools for more fun and interesting player builds, additional plants to farm and recipes, as well as immersive textures to give a realistic look without taking away from the staple 'Minecraft' feel, there are also performance-boosting mods to ensure players on lower-end PCs can enjoy the pack as well. There are also mods to make for more engaging roleplay, such as allowing player models to sit and interact with one another, and much more.
